story.title: About Mingo
story.belief: At Mingo Ice Cream, we believe everyone deserves to enjoy quality ice cream. After all, everybody loves ice cream.

history.title: History
history.kicker: Bringing a world of joy and fun since our humble beginnings in 2009
history.paragraphOne: Mingo Ice Cream started in 2009. Although our beginnings were humble, we brought traditional recipes from Asia to a wide range of dessert ice creams. Each recipe is thoughtfully adapted for different tastes while preserving its fresh, delicious character.
history.paragraphTwo: We put passion into every tub, cup and stick we make. Today, Mingo and our Rokka, Oasis and Fruitesia brands can be found across several countries in the region.

hero.placeholder: What kind of job are you looking for?

contentMarketing.title: Content Marketing
contentMarketing.description: Madly in love with ice-cold ice cream? Obsessed with pulling off wild and crazy stunts for explosive campaigns? Catching trends faster than ice cream melts under the sun? Help Mingo tell joyful brand stories.

contentMarketingIntern.title: Content Marketing Intern
contentMarketingIntern.description: Are you crazy about refreshing ice cream, love making bold campaign ideas and catching trends faster than ice cream melts under the sun? Come and explore new experiences with Mingo.

detail.applicationNote: Ready to create sweet campaigns with Mingo? Send your CV and portfolio to our recruitment team.

items.one: Develop and deliver content ideas for Mingo's communication channels.
items.two: Work with design and marketing teams to execute campaigns on schedule.
items.three: Track trends, measure performance and recommend content improvements.

items.one: A genuine interest in content, branding and consumer products.
items.two: Clear writing, proactive collaboration and good time management skills.
items.three: Familiarity with social media tools; a portfolio is an advantage.

items.one: A friendly, youthful workplace that encourages experimentation.
items.two: Hands-on mentoring and opportunities to join real Mingo campaigns.
items.three: Competitive benefits and long-term development opportunities.
